verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a local Unix-like terminal for iOS, not a VPN or mesh-networking product, so subnet routing is the wrong axis for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a feature: the network-related items (nslookup/whois commands and an optional local relay HTTPS server) are not subnet routers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use subnet routers to reach devices outside my local network as if I were on it
